lead: A `nvs-host` test makes a context *fail* with `Ctx::set_pending("message")`, not with `Thrown::new`.
body: `Thrown::new` is `unsafe` and wants a `*const ClassDesc`; `set_pending` takes a bare message and `take_thrown` promotes it through the context's error class. A *named* failure needs one installed first (`ClassTable::define("Throwable", &["message", "previous", "backtrace", "location"], &[])` plus `set_runtime_error_class`); without one `take_thrown` answers a null `Thrown`.
